description: Read a single stat: latest value, recent series, and basic summary (count/min/max/avg/sum). Use this for a structured read of one metric — prefer `ask_ezstat` for free-form questions over many stats.

from.description: Unix-seconds lower bound (inclusive). Omit for "last 24 hours".

resolution.description: Optional rollup resolution. Omit for raw points.

name: read_stat
